why: A village plus a ruined portal with chests next to spawn is the kind of spawn runners reset to find: quick loot and a fast portal. This exact seed and spawn produced a verified 2:54.545 Any% Glitchless run (dumbo0116, 1.16.5, Easy, set seed), so keeping it is correct.
trap: Reset because the stronghold location is unknown or because there is no lava visible. The chests and the ruined portal make the portal fast without lava.

techniques.description: Keep spawns with a village and a ruined portal in view.
techniques.source: https://www.speedrun.com/mc/runs/yoex3d0z (verified run on this seed); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minecraft_speedrunning (section on resetting; raw wikitext line 48, fetched 2026-11-06)
